_comment: Authoritative tuning numbers for JAFS requirements (REQ-078). Every other view (requirements text, generated config comments, tests that assert defaults, public documentation) is derived from this file and must be re-checked when a value here changes. Durations in seconds unless stated.
source: owner draft brief Section 10, accepted with ranges on 2026-10-08 (owner: all A)

activeFoodLimit.purpose: Maximum simultaneous active foods per player.

eligibilityThreshold.purpose: An active food is eligible for refresh or replacement when its remaining duration is strictly below this percent of its full duration.

fullDuration.purpose: Full duration per food definition. Mandatory; no global fallback. The documentation examples use 1200 (20 minutes).

baseRecoveryRate.unit: percent of maximum health per second
baseRecoveryRate.purpose: Health restored per second once recovery is active.

depletionRate.purpose: Speed of active-food timers. 0 pauses natural depletion.

hungerEffectIncrement.purpose: Added to the depletion rate for each level of the Hunger effect (level I adds once).

inhibitedBlocksRecovery.purpose: Block recovery while the Inhibited effect is active. Has no effect when Inhibited is not installed.

pinnedFoodLevel.purpose: The food level JAFS holds every player at. Not configurable (owner decision 2026-10-08).

hudAnchor.purpose: Anchor for the active-food HUD (REV-012 added the middle pair); the default sits near the hotbar.

hudGrowth.purpose: Row or column layout of the HUD slots and the end the first slot starts from (REV-012).

showUnconfiguredTooltip.purpose: Show the 'No food bonuses configured' tooltip line.

propertyColorOverrides.purpose: Map of property id to display color, overriding provider defaults.

diagnosticMode.purpose: Log one line per JAFS decision (see REQ-076). Off by default.

timerCorrectionInterval.purpose: How often the server corrects client-side countdowns when nothing else changed.

clientTimerTolerance.purpose: Maximum allowed difference between the HUD countdown and the server value.
